tweet.text:
Great day today.
Working on http://github.com/unclebob/spacewar.  
I used grok to convert 389 tests from 'midge' to 'speclj'.  It did a 95% job.  Pretty smart; and also pretty dumb.

Then I spent the day making a fundamental design change to the way goods are transported between bases.  This increased performance significantly.

It's amazing how easy it is to jump back into a clojure codebase that I haven't touched for a year or more.
